newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi Arabia to raise Asia Nov crude price - traders.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia to raise Asia Nov crude price - traders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has said it will raise its November-lifting crude price formula to Asian customers by five to 15 cents a barrel, traders said on Thursday.
The November term contract price for Arab Light has been set at the Oman/Dubai differential plus 60 cents, compared to plus 55 cents for October, traders said.
November Arab Medium will be priced at the Oman/Dubai differential minus 30 cents, Arab Heavy at a discount of $1.05, and Arab Extra Light at a premium of $1.55, traders said.
October Arab Medium, Arab Heavy and Arab Extra Light were set at the Oman/Dubai differential minus 40 cents, minus $1.10, and plus $1.40 respectively.
